from __future__ import annotations

from typing import List, Optional

from fastapi import APIRouter, status
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

router = APIRouter()

# In‑memory mock storage
items_db: List[Item] = []


class Item(BaseModel):
    """Schema representing an item.

    Attributes
    ----------
    id: int
        Unique identifier for the item.
    name: str
        Human‑readable name of the item.
    description: Optional[str]
        Optional longer description.
    """

    id: int = Field(..., description="Unique identifier for the item")
    name: str = Field(..., description="Name of the item")
    description: Optional[str] = Field(
        default=None,
        description="Optional detailed description of the item",
    )


@router.post(
    "/items",
    response_model=Item,
    status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED,
    tags=["items"],
)
def create_item(item: Item) -> Item:
    """Store a new item in the in‑memory list.

    Parameters
    ----------
    item: Item
        The item payload received from the client.

    Returns
    -------
    Item
        The stored item, echoed back to the client.
    """
    items_db.append(item)
    return item
